product_metadata.title: B&C Home Goods Set of 6 Luxury Wooden Hangers - Extra Wide Wood Coat Suit Hangers with Velvet Bar for Coats Clothes and Pants - Wide Shoulder
features: LUXURY HANGERS: Set of 6 high-end hangers feature a solid wood construction and smooth dark brown finish.

NON-SLIP VELVET WRAPPED BAR: You won't find cheap plastic or rubber on these hangers! Each hanger features a 16 inch long solid wood bar wrapped in luxurious black velvet that keeps clothes from slipping and snagging.
EXTRA-STRENGTH: Instead of using cheap and flimsy nails or glue to hold them together, these hangers are assembled with heavy duty screws supporting even the heaviest of coats or suits.
ANTI-RUST 360° ROTATING HOOK: Each hanger in this set of five features a metal hook that won’t rust and that swivels a full 360° making them versatile and easy to hang.

EXTRA-WIDE SHOULDERS: Wider shoulders on the hangers prevent clothes from slipping off and help them retain their shape. If you're not happy with your purchase we promise to make it right and go above and beyond. Customer satisfaction is our #1 priority.
description: Solid Wood Extra-Strength Suit Hangers with Velvet Non-slip bar and Anti-Rust Hook
